# Acquired positive-operator certificates for a hidden qubit algebra

28 October 2026. Root candidate. This is a new construction, not an expansion of received scalar whitening by association. Independent algebra challenge has found no flaw, but full finite acquisition review remains pending.

## 1. The obstruction and changed representation

Scalar Gram whitening fails when the noise contraction varies together with a spectator record. Operator-valued anticommutator whitening resolves commuting sectors, but generally fails when the spectator coefficients do not commute. Instead fit a physical Pauli algebra and certify a POSITIVE OPERATOR-BLOCK representation of its measured contrasts. The positive block supplies a global variational certificate, not a microscopic environmental model.

On a finite output envelope of dimension d=2g let B_X,B_Y,B_Z be an unknown physical Pauli triple: Hermitian unitaries, pairwise anticommuting, B_Y=i B_X B_Z. The true ordinary signed contrasts satisfy

    C_j=sum_k B_k T_kj,
    T_kj=T_jk=T_kj dagger,
    [T_kj,B_a]=0 for every a,
    T=[T_jk]_(j,k=1)^3 >=0 on C^3 tensor C^d.       (1)

The entries of T need NOT commute with each other. All C_j are Hermitian. For the complete n-qubit inverse claim below, ALL local triples must arise from ONE fixed global unitary V: B_(i,j)=V sigma_(i,j) V dagger. Thus different input-qubit algebras commute and jointly represent the full n-qubit algebra; unrelated locally valid triples do not suffice. This is a structural promise on actual reduced conditional means, not something arbitrary finite observations prove about a source. Positive semidefinite T suffices for soundness; a strictly positive margin is needed for the completion guarantee below.

Actual physical examples include history-dependent mixtures of product qubit channels whose own-qubit Bloch matrices are symmetric positive definite but may have different unknown damping axes. Before a common fixed output mixer, each component contributes a positive scalar3-by-3 contraction times its positive spectator state. Their sum is a positive operator block. On an envelope containing the entire true own-qubit algebra, partial trace preserves block positivity, entry symmetry and commutation with that algebra. # The full channel-oracle normal cone of a qubit subsystem extractor

28 October 2026. New candidate theorem and acquisition certificate; independent internal review pending. This extends the positive-operator-block certificate at the objective level. It does NOT inherit that source's coarse localization premises or establish historical novelty.

## 1. Physical channel and conventions

Let N:M_2->M_d be any physical qubit-input CPTP channel, d=2g, and define its three ordinary signed contrasts C_j=N(sigma_j/2), j=X,Y,Z. They are Hermitian and traceless. Let B_j=U(sigma_j tensor I_g)Udagger be a fixed physical Pauli triple on the receiver. Its extraction channel is D_B=Tr_G Ad_Udagger.

Every physical CPTP decoder D:M_d->M_2 has a unital-CP adjoint with images A_j=D^*(sigma_j). In auxiliary-qubit/receiver order its unital-map Choi matrix is

 K_A=(I_2 tensor I_d+sum_j sigma_j^T tensor A_j)/2,
 K_A>=0, Tr_aux K_A=I_d, Tr K_A=d.

Set H_C=sum_j sigma_j^T tensor C_j and J_C(A)=sum_j Tr(C_j A_j). Then

 Tr(H_C K_A)=J_C(A),
 F_e(D N)=(1+J_C(A))/4.                                      (1)

The factor1/4 in fidelity is essential: all curvature statements below first concern the UNSCALED objective J_C. The N(I/2) term contributes the fixed1/4 because N,D are trace preserving.

At the subsystem extractor K_B=2P_B, where P_B is the rank-g projection onto the logical maximally entangled vector tensor the full gauge space, transported by I_aux tensor U. This full gauge support is material to the necessity statement.

## 2. Necessary AND sufficient normal-cone characterization

Define the ordered matrix

 Y_B=sum_j C_j B_j,
 Q_B=I_2 tensor Y_B-H_C.                                     (2)

Then the fixed extraction D_B maximizes entanglement fidelity among ALL CPTP decoders if and only if

 Y_B is Hermitian and Q_B>=0.                                (3)

No assumption that C_j B_j is individually Hermitian, that different gauge coefficients commute, or that a positive operator-block representation exists is required.

Proof. The exact finite SDP is maximize Tr(H_C K), K>=0, Tr_aux K=I_d. Its dual is minimize Tr Y over Hermitian Y with I_2 tensor Y-H_C>=0. # Finite learned localization from disjoint-competitor oracle scores

28 October 2026. New candidate acquisition mechanism; separate internal review required. This replaces the FAILED inference that normal-cone channels have zero signed contrast on every disjoint interval. It uses simultaneous optimal-score comparisons from one common actual channel bank.

## 1. Structural and physical contract

A qubit-input source has n ordered physical output qubits. There is ONE fixed physical Pauli triple B_j on the full output, supported on an unknown nonempty interval I of length<=w, with w<=n known. At every exposed calibration history, the current reduced qubit-to-output channel N_t is CPTP, selected before the current private input/readout coins. Its three contrasts C_(t,j)=N_t(sigma_j/2) satisfy the full oracle normal cone of B:

 Y_(t,B)=sum_j C_(t,j)B_j is Hermitian,
 Q_(t,B)=I_2 tensor Y_(t,B)-sum_j sigma_j^T tensor C_(t,j)>=0.

The source may retain quantum memory and change with past observed history. Its actual conditional memory is positive; current probe inputs are freshly prepared independently of that memory. All local means in a comparison bank must arise from the SAME average global channel Nbar=(1/N)sum_t N_t. Private randomized settings below ensure this. Alternatively a fixed stationary independently restarted channel is a sufficient special case. Separate setting/interval banks with uncontrolled history-changing noise do NOT supply comparable scores.

This is a trusted qualitative source contract, not certified by finite data. The source need not have a positive operator-block factorization and may have gauge-only input contrasts. For eventual completion we separately assume a uniform positive full-output dual gap Q_(t,B)>=mu0(I-P_B), mu0>0 over the relevant histories; its numerical value is NOT an input to the observed acceptance guard. Finite funded caps can always abstain.

## 2. One actual ordinary bank supplies all local contrasts

Enumerate ALL nonempty intervals J of lengths1,...,w, not only intervals of lengthw. Measure every physical output qubit in an independently uniform Pauli axis. Retain input axis/sign, output axes and binary outcomes.
